message.content:
A hexagon has 6 vertices. A triangle is determined by choosing any 3 of these vertices.

Since no three vertices are collinear, every choice of 3 vertices forms a triangle.

\[
\binom{6}{3}=\frac{6\cdot 5\cdot 4}{3\cdot 2\cdot 1}=20
\]

The answer is 20.
